column7: description
Big, cuddly, but don’t steal its snacks!
Self-proclaimed ruler of the game. You serve it now.
Climbs anything, eats everything, fears nothing! This hoofed hooligan is chaos on four legs!
Chill, chunky, and full of charm. This cow loves naps, snacks, and occasional stampedes when nobody’s looking.
Graceful, speedy… scared of literally everything.
Loyal, goofy, and always chasing things he’ll never catch, like his own tail. Your new best buddy!
Bright, bouncy, and possibly poisonous! This little hopper’s got big jumps, loud croaks, and zero chill. Ribbit!
Silent, sleek, and faster than your Wi-Fi! This jungle ninja strikes hard, naps harder, and always looks cool doing it
Hops around like it drank five energy drinks.
This overly enthusiastic log-chewer thinks everything is a dam project. Will chew your enemies’ defenses… or your furniture
Nature’s grumpy garden gnome. Digging tunnels, fighting bees, and looking perpetually annoyed since forever.
A crocodile’s sneaky cousin who lurks like it’s always planning a prank — and maybe it is.
The chillest creature alive. Basically a furry potato that vibes with everyone. Even caimans
Tiny sideways tank. Pinches first, asks questions never. Sandcastle destroyer by trade.
A smiley ocean genius who surfs waves and judges your intelligence. Secretly plotting something.
Quack-powered chaos in a feathery tuxedo. Cute, loud, occasionally terrifying.
Lounge lizard with a mohawk. Too cool to move fast. Loves sunbathing and salad.
A majestic forest horse with tree-branch antlers and zero understanding of personal space.
Floating fuzzballs who hold hands, crack shellfish, and look like they’re in a soap opera.
Feathered librarian of the woods. Sees all. Knows all. Might judge your grammar.
Trash panda extraordinaire. Masked like a bandit, snacks like a king.
Loud beach hooligan with a hunger for fries and no respect for picnics.
Toothy sea missile. Not evil, just misunderstood and really into cardio.
Flying rainbow with a fruit slicer for a face. Lives in style, squawks in stereo.
Tiny night goblin with built-in sonar and a flair for the dramatic.
Smiling water gremlin that refuses to grow up, literally.
Hyperactive tree ninja with acorn hoarding issues.
Ginger floof who’s sure a dramatic tail swish can solve literally anything.
Standing on one leg because drama is a lifestyle.
Pocket rocket in a fur coat, buzzing from vine to vine while inventing brand-new jungle sound effects
Mane-whipping wind machine posing for epic photos, then sideways-jumping at imaginary ghosts just for fun
Stripey horse with commitment issues. Can’t pick black or white, so went with both.
Walking skyscraper with spots, sass, and zero neck control.
Savanna’s drama king. Big hair, big roar, bigger ego.
